notes.rule: Casting spells that would reduce REASON, instead increase DOOM.
The option to ESCAPE from combat is disabled.

events.name: Small Cocoon
choices: Forced -2 REASON, randomly gain either [NICE RING], [PATINA RING] or [ROCK RING].

notes.rule: The MISERY PARASITE status grows at the start of each mystery, gaining special conditions that will inflict DOOM at the end of mysteries.
ruledetaillist: +2% DOOM for each SPELL you know.
+2% DOOM for each ALLY you have.
+2% DOOM for each ITEM held, not equipped.
+1% DOOM for each INJURY you have.
+1% DOOM for each CURSE you have.
+1% DOOM for every 10 EXPERIENCE you have, rounded down.

thing-forsaken-by-god.name: Goizo, the Thing Forsaken by God

notes.rule: RESTING causes +2% additional DOOM compared to the base rate for your difficulty.
Completing a mystery triggers 1 additional Town Status.

events.name: The Trumpets of Shiokawa
choices: FIGHT: -1% DOOM gain a random INJURY.

notes.rule: Both you and enemies deal +1 additional combat damage.

events.name: Pillar of Flame
choices: DEXTERITY check: Gain the SPELL Ithotu Flame on success, +2% DOOM on failure.

notes.rule: Gain +1% DOOM for every 2 REASON lost, rounded up, and a status to lose an additional -2% DOOM at the end of a mystery.

events.name: Bad Dreams
choices: YOU CAN'T: Gain the INSOMNIA status.

events.name: Crumbling Reality
choices: DEVOURED: +3 EXPERIENCE, enter random OTHERWORLD location.
FIGHT IT: PERCEPTION check: Gain +4 REASON on success, -2 STAMINA on failure.

notes.rule: Each turn 2-3 locations are forbidden; INVESTIGATING there causes an additional +2% DOOM. [Don't Blink] incurs no penalty.

horror-from-the-stars.name: Zhectast, The Horror from the Stars

notes.rule: Permanently lose -1 to all stats for every 21% of DOOM reached for the first time.
